⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities

1. Assessment Fairness

Consistent descriptor scoring across all assessment providers. Standardised evidence requirements. No postcode lottery in WCA outcomes. Fair treatment for fluctuating conditions.

2. Mental Health Parity

Equal weight for mental health descriptors. Specialist mental health assessors. Fluctuating condition support. Crisis safety integration. Therapeutic engagement recognition.

3. Evidence-Based Decisions

All WCA decisions based on comprehensive medical evidence. GP, hospital, and specialist evidence integration. No assessment without pre-gathered evidence package.

4. Transparent Scoring

Claimant-accessible descriptor scoring breakdown. Clear explanation of points awarded. Real-time assessment tracking. Appeal-ready documentation from day one.

5. Appeal Protection

Right to mandatory reconsideration before tribunal. No benefit reduction during appeal. Fast-track for terminal illness. Legal aid access preserved for WCA disputes.

6. Provider Accountability

Real-time assessment provider quality metrics. Decision accuracy targets. Claimant satisfaction monitoring. Automatic escalation for poor performance.

7. Reform Readiness

AI-ready for WCA reform implementation. New descriptor framework compatibility. Smooth transition for existing claimants. Pilot programme evaluation infrastructure.

8. Parliamentary Oversight

Real-time WCA dashboard. Assessment outcome reporting. Disparity tracking. Mortality review integration. Reform effectiveness metrics. Independent review automation.

🚫 Red Lines (Never Crossed)

  • ❌ No WCA decision made without comprehensive pre-gathered medical evidence package from GP, hospital, and specialist sources
  • ❌ No assessment conducted without claimant notification, accessibility adjustments, and right to representation
  • ❌ No descriptor scoring applied without consistency validation against national benchmarks and provider quality metrics
  • ❌ No LCW/LCWRA decision without mental health specialist review for claimants with psychological conditions
  • ❌ No benefit reduction based on WCA outcome without mandatory reconsideration window and appeal right notification
  • ❌ No assessment provider contract renewed without meeting minimum accuracy, fairness, and claimant satisfaction thresholds
